Diggersby

Normal Ground

Kalos · Generation 6

Diggersby is a Normal/Ground-type Digging Pokémon first found in Kalos (Generation 6). It stands 1 m tall and weighs 42.4 kg. It evolves from Bunnelby. Its highest base stat is HP (85), with a base stat total of 423.
